items.title: Ruben Amorim admits to Man Utd ‘mistakes’ with AC Milan manager fearing history is repeating itself
items.summary: FORMER Manchester United head coach Ruben Amorim has admitted to making "mistakes" at Old Trafford and says he is learning from them with AC Milan. Amorim continued his unbeaten start to the Serie A season at the weekend with a 3-0 win over Lecce. It left AC Milan fifth in the table with 11 points..
